autoadd.title: Auto add friends
autoadd.subtitle: Requests via API
autoadd.intro: Sends requests from VK recommendations via API, without the search page. Excludes friends, subscriptions and incoming requests.
autoadd.status_hint: Set limits and acknowledge the risk
autoadd.params_desc: Attempt limits and intervals between requests
autoadd.warn_body: CAPTCHA or bans are possible even within limits.
autoadd.acknowledge: I understand the risk and proceed at my own risk.
autoadd.local_limits: Local ceilings: 20 attempts per hour, 50 per 24 hours and 20 per run; 30–600 second delays, 10,000 friends and 1,000 outgoing requests. Hourly and daily limits use rolling windows and survive restarts. Failed attempts count too. VK may impose stricter limits. Any error or API warning stops the script without retries. Stopping cannot undo an already dispatched request.
autoadd.invalid_delay: Maximum delay must be at least the minimum.

reasons.error: Stopped due to an error or warning
reasons.interrupted: Run interrupted; the last attempt may be unresolved. No automatic retry.
reasons.hour_limit: Hourly limit. Retry when capacity is available.
reasons.day_limit: 24-hour limit. Retry when capacity is available.

errors.14: VK requires CAPTCHA. Check the account manually.
errors.TOKEN_EXPIRED: Token expired or account validation required
errors.ACCOUNT_CHANGED: Account changed. Start again for the intended account.
errors.REQUEST_ACCEPTED: VK accepted an incoming request instead of sending a new one
errors.TIMEOUT: No response; request outcome may be unknown. No retry.
errors.INVALID_USER_LIST: Use IDs or vk.ru/id… links: TXT, CSV with an id column, JSON array or object with ids.

autoadd.parser_hint: Community lists: Center → Communities → Member parser.
autoadd.parser_source: Parser result; partial lists are available too.
